name: calories-calculator
description: A self-contained, single-file HTML/CSS/JS nutrition tracker (Cronometer-style, Indian + international food focus). No build tooling, no framework, no backend — everything runs client-side and persists to `localStorage`.

scripts.build:android: npm run build && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.build:ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.build:web: npm run build && echo 'Web build complete. Open dist/index.html in a browser.'
